description: Scan a public website and return an AI-readiness score (0-100), sub-scores, AI-bot robots.txt access, and a list of issues with concrete fixes. Use when a user asks if a site is visible/optimized for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini or AI search.

category.description: Optional site category; changes which schema types count as required.

url.description: Domain or URL to scan, e.g. example.com

name: check_ai_readiness
title: Check AI readiness of a website
